description:
FILED s543k (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-22), found by member 2's probe b18 (#5270).  PRE-EXISTING: base 4a0fd0ec the same.

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 | ./runpcl):
    open(my $fh, "<", $0) or die;
    my $g = eval q{$fh};
    print ref($fh), "|", ref($g), "|", ref(eval q{$fh}), "|", ref(eval q{\*STDOUT}), "|", ref(scalar eval q{$fh}), "\n";
        perl  GLOB|GLOB|GLOB|GLOB|GLOB        PCL  GLOB|GLOB||GLOB|

WHAT IT IS: the eval's VALUE handed DIRECTLY to `ref` (no variable in between) answers "" for a lexical handle; through `my $g` it is right, and `\*STDOUT` is right.  Suspect (not measured): the value p-eval returns (%p-leavesub's mortal copy of the handle box) is a form p-ref reads as a non-reference, while the scalar assignment unwraps it.  Cheap measurement: `(p-ref (p-eval "$fh" ...))` vs `(p-ref (p-scalar-= tmp (p-eval ...)))` at the REPL -- print (type-of) of p-eval's return for a handle-holding box.
=== DONE (s543m, Opus 5.5, 2026-11-24) ===
THE MEASUREMENT: `(type-of ...)` at the REPL (a transpiled program + a debug load): p-eval's value for `eval q{$fh}`, a sub's implicit `$fh` tail and `return $fh` are all the RAW sb-sys:fd-stream (no box); the variable is a box holding it.  p-ref answers "" for a raw stream -- rightly: the raw stream is PCL's glob VALUE (`$$fh`), the BOX is what makes it a glob ref (#1308).  So the sub-return twin (`ref(f())`) was the same defect, and `ref(scalar(f()))` too.
THE ONE PLACE: both frame exits (p-return-value, %p-leavesub-scalar -- the string eval's catch runs the latter, #987) kept a box only for a hash / vector / function payload, each with its own copy of that test.  ONE predicate %p-ref-payload-p (+ %p-handle-payload-p: a stream, a socket, a dirhandle) for both; p-scalar's box arms gain the handle (scalar() never dereferences).  The general question: an rvalue straight out of an eval / a sub return lost its reference-ness only at the frame exit; `do { $fh }` (no frame), list stores (`my @a = (f())`, a hash value, map / grep) and the stringification were right already.
PROBES: scratch/s543m/p4/m4.pl 12 lines: base 8, tree 10 -- the two left (`fileno(f())`, `readline(f())`) read the BAREWORD handle `f`: a call in a glob slot, filed #5400.  Breaking shapes (`*G = o()`, `print {o()}`, `*{o()}{IO}`, `open my $d, ">&", o()`, a closure's return, a list / hash element): base = tree (p4/brk.pl).
GUARD: Pl/t/return-copy-01.t row 10 (FAILS on the base).  Commit d90e38ec (WIP 3).

FINAL SHAS (s543m, 2026-11-27, after the stacked rebase onto s543n 9a3ce86f and main 0be2848a; the notes above cite pre-rebase shas): 26543df0 (WIP 3).
frequency_reason: `ref(eval q{$fh})` with no variable in between (first pass from the subject, the reviewing session 2026-11-24)
subject: SILENT WRONG: `ref(eval q{$fh})` of a lexical filehandle is "" (perl GLOB); `my $g = eval q{$fh}; ref $g` is right
triage_reason: a silent wrong of ref() on an ordinary string-eval value: IN
